company.name: Augment Code
company.shortDescription: Augment Code is an AI-powered platform for software development that provides services for chat, code completions, and guided edits.
company.description: Augment Code builds AI agents that understand entire codebases to generate, review, and manage software. It offers deep contextual code comprehension, IDE and CLI integration, and automated task coordination. Developers can also leverage semantic code analysis, remote agents, and personalized prompt suggestions to streamline complex projects.

aiResearchSummary.text: Augment Code is researching AI powered software development tools. Using natural language to perform context aware code generation describes receiving code selections and natural language tasks, then generating modifications using a knowledge base. Fill in the middle code completions using static code analysis focuses on prefix and suffix based completions. Enterprise specific code generation using generative artificial intelligence targets client specific code bases. Together these cover chat like edits, completions, and guided code changes.
